diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says VIN-, datasheet reading says V-
diffs.evidence: Adafruit 1164 EAGLE board file: header JP1 pad 3 is on signal "VIN-" (with RSHUNT pad 1, terminal block J1 pad 1 and INA169 U1 pin 4 = VIN-), and the top silkscreen text under it reads "VIN-" (<text x="10.16" y="4.064" layer="21">VIN-</text>; header order VCC, GND, VIN-, VIN+, OUT). Same net, same pin position; the second reading's "V-" is an abbreviation of the same load-side shunt pin, and the model uses the exact silkscreen label.

diffs.diff: header pin 4: part says VIN+, datasheet reading says V+
diffs.evidence: Adafruit 1164 EAGLE board file: header JP1 pad 4 is on signal "VIN+" (with RSHUNT pad 2, terminal block J1 pad 2 and INA169 U1 pin 3 = VIN+), and the top silkscreen text reads "VIN+" (<text x="12.7" y="0.254" layer="21">VIN+</text>). Same net and position; "V+" is an abbreviation of the supply-side shunt pin, and the model uses the exact silkscreen label.
